title: Unnamed group extended low-dose DMT to 6 hours

tellings.quote: Another group has extended it for 6 hours at a very low dose level.

plain: A research group has extended the DMT experience to six hours at a very low dose, according to the neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore. DMT is a powerful psychedelic whose trip normally lasts minutes, and Gallimore, who does not name the group, tells Michels this as a step toward longer stays in what he sees as another realm.
